publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for the detection and classification of acute leukemia from lymphoblastic cell images. It introduces a compact multi- column Convolution Neural Network model that to efficiently distinguish leukemic cells from healthy ones. The proposed model achieves an accuracy of 97.5% with only one-fifth the amount of parameters as that of the state-of-the-art. This research holds significant potential for advancing accurate medical image-based diagnosis, enhancing leukemia detection and screening.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Cobalt Ferrite Nanoparticles for Supercapacitor Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: In this paper, we synthesize and characterize cobalt ferrite (CoFe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) nanoparticles via the Hydrothermal method. The material's structure, morphology, dielectric, and electrical responses were examined. Annealing at temperatures (800 °C, 900 °C, 1000 °C) influenced dielectric properties, impacting electro transport due to semiconductor behavior. As calcination temperature increased, resistance decreased. This study offers insights into cobalt ferrite nanoparticle synthesis, characterization, and electrical properties, with implications for energy storage super-capacitor applications.

articleTitle: Transmitter Localization with Minimal Interference in Off-body Communication for Wearable Implants
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: With the proliferation of wearable implant devices, like medical sensors and IoT-enabled gadgets undergoing off-body communication, there is a growing need for interference-free communication in indoor body area network with multiple access points (APs). This paper aims to solve the problem of optimal localization of APs and WI users in a room with two APs, thereby minimizing the interference utilizing phase-difference parameters, hence enhancing the overall system performance.

articleTitle: RF source for shock free plasma application on living skin
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: In this work, a shock-free RF power supply circuit is developed for cold atmospheric plasma (CAP) jet. The plasma discharge characteristics are investigated from the voltage and current waveforms at 100 kHz frequency. 100 kHz frequency offer better skin depth and that is essential to generate shock free plasma. The plasma plume (jet) temperature is measured where the Ar gas flow rate maintained at 7 sL/min. Several micro-discharges are observed in the plasma plume region. Voluntarily one of the co-authors himself applied this discharge plume on his finger without anesthesia to check the immediate effect of electrical shock and the post irradiation effect.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Low Power High Performance F-Shaped Graphene Nanoribbon Tunnel Field Effect Transistor
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: F-Shaped Graphene Nanoribbon (GNR) Tunnel Field Effect Transistors (TFET) is analyzed and modeled. Computer-based software (SILVACO TCAD) calculates and validates the device drain current. The F-Shaped GNR TFET's channel length, width, and gate oxide thickness are all optimized to produce a higher on-off current ratio, low subthreshold swing, and high on or drain current. Therefore F-Shaped GNR TFET is promising next-generation semiconductors for low-power digital systems.

articleTitle: D-Band Slotted Waveguide Array Antenna for LOS Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: The paper presents a highly efficient linearly polarized slotted waveguide array antenna at D band. It consists of 8x8 array of slot, which are excited adopting parallel plate waveguide (PPW) technique. A feeding slot is used to excite a TE810 mode cavity and the eight coupling slots have been conceived on this cavity that are used to excite the overall 8X8 slot array. Feeding of the antenna is made in such a way that the coupling slots produces equal but 180° out of phase excitation alternatively. The PPWs are excited by eight coupling slots in alternate phase arrangement where electric fields are cancelled at waveguide walls to create virtual shorts. Silver based epoxy bonding is used to reduce assembly complexity and conductive losses. The antenna promises 7.85% impedance bandwidth (from 135GHz to 146GHz) with about 24 dBi of gain. It exhibits an excellent gain stability of ± 0.5 dBi over the operating band.

articleTitle: Hemodynamic Analysis for Assessing Creative Skill of Subjects Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: The paper introduces an innovative method for evaluating the scientific creative potential of subjects from their analogical reasoning ability using functional Near Infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS). The fNIRS signals acquired from the subjects during analogical problem solving are transmitted to a novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) after pre-processing to identify two class labels: creative and non-creative. Executed experiments reveal the proposed model’s effectiveness compared to its traditional counterparts, substantiating its superiority.

articleTitle: Bi-functional Metasurface Based Wideband Cross-Polarizer and Narrowband Absorber
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: A thin, compact bi-functional metasurface for wideband cross-polarization conversion (CPC) and narrowband absorber has been reported in this paper. The proposed metal-dielectric-metal layer meta-atom contains circular split rings and four L-shaped metal strips on the top layer, FR-4 substrate in the middle layer, and the copper ground plane on the bottom layer. A wide band cross-polarization conversion from 12.8 to 24.7 GHz and narrow band absorptance from 30.5 to 31.2 GHz has been observed with the designed metasurface. Both functions of the metasurface are angularly stable for the incident plane wave up to 20°.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Measurement Device Independent Quantum Key Distribution Protocol on Optisystem
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: We have implemented Measurement Device Independent Quantum Key Distribution protocol on Optisystem 7.0 software; which shows robustness against different detector side channel attacks. Our encoding is totally done by the different polarizing angles of a photon which is done by the linear polarizers and also with the help of Quarter Waveplates. By changing different components parameters, we are able to show different perspective of the protocol like security maintenance, flipping the bits, basis mismatching etc.

articleTitle: Novel Design of Flexible Microwave Photonics Filter for Communication Payload
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: Microwave Photonic Filter (MPF) is an alternative of RF filter where tunability and selectivity is prime concern. In MPF, input RF signals is modulated by optical carrier, processed optically and finally converted to electrical domain by photodetector. The paper discuss about MPF design having flexible tunability and configurability using stimulated Brillouin scattering effect in single mode fiber. Simulation results show the proposed design of MPF has a broad tunability range of 1 GHz to 20 GHz and side band rejection upto 20 dB in 20 MHz frequency offset from the edge of the frequency.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Suitability and Performance Metrics of Free Space Optics for Smart City Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: Free Space Optics (FSO) has gained importance as a promising solution because of its capacity for high data rates, security features, and resistance to electromagnetic interference. In this study, we have assessed the appropriateness and conducted an analysis of the performance parameters of a Free Space Optics (FSO) system. In this paper, simulation design and performance analysis of the WDM FSO System is carried out using Optisystem 20.0 software

articleTitle: Metal loaded 3D-FSS with adjustable Transmission Poles and Transmission Zeros
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: A novel design of three-dimensional (3D) Frequency Selective Surface (FSS) with rejection band and pass band characteristics is presented in this article. The ring shaped metallic layer incorporation inside the circular cavity of the dielectric substrate along with the rectangular thin metal layer enclosure outside the substrate periphery yields a pass band pole and stop band zero. The fractional band width enhancement of stop band and the pass band using the independent adjustable transmission pole and zero exhibits the excellence of the proposed work.

articleTitle: On the Identification of Statistically Significant Biomarkers for the Detection of Dementia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: Brain anatomy is severely degraded during the progression of dementia among the elderly population. This paper makes a thorough statistical study in identifying the parameters responsible for the progression of a deadly form of dementia, called Alzheimer’s disease (AD). In connection to this, percentage volumes of cerebrum, cerebellum and brain stem have been employed for a subsequent z-test based analysis.

articleTitle: Impact of channel thickness on the performance of a-IGZO Thin Film Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: In this work, effect of active layer thickness on the performance of a-IGZO based TFT has been studied by using ATLAS 2D device simulator of SILVACO TCAD software. Here, the effect of channel thickness on electrical performance of the device was studied. High mobility (> 51cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>) was observed for all TFTs. Threshold voltage shows an incremental nature with channel thickness. Subthreshold value and current ratio show deterioration with increase in channel thickness.

articleTitle: A Novel Sleep Cycle Modulated Energy Harvesting policy for Three Tier 5G Ultra Dense HetNet
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel Sleep Cycle Modulated Energy Harvesting (SCMEH) policy is proposed for Small cell eNodeBs (SeNB) in a 5G three tier Ultra Dense Heterogeneous Network (UDHetNet) to ensure proper utilization of energy resources. An analytical model based on Continuous Time Markov Chain is also designed to evaluate the proposed SCMEH policy. The comprehensive performance analysis finds that the implementation of SCMEH enabled SeNBs under UDHetNet can ensure Sustainable Green Communication by enabling better utilization of the available energy resources under varying urban tele-traffic conditions.

articleTitle: Comparison of GNSS TEC with IRI 2016 derived TEC over low latitude stations Bangalore and Hyderabad from India
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: Total Electron Content is an important parameter of ionosphere which affects radio wave propagation. Vertical Total Electron Content obtained from IGS stations IISC, Bangalore(13.02°N,77.57°E), and Hyderabad(17.41°N,78.55°E), situated near magnetic equator and near northern anomaly crest respectively, have been compared with IRI 2016 derived TEC during March 2014, equinoctial month of high solar activity year. It is found that model data gives lower value compared to the observed data during daytime.

articleTitle: An investigation on a four-channel 3D network modelfor underwater RF communication
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: Underwater wireless communication plays significant role in environmental monitoring, gas and oil exploration, and warfare. In this paper an investigation on a four channel 3D network model is one for underwater RF communication. The throughput of the proposed network model is calculated using a mathematical model and then the results are presented by observing it for variety of parameters. Path loss is analyzed for both free space and underwater RF communication.

articleTitle: Linear-Regression based Simple Empirical Model for Estimating the Band gap of Semiconducting-Nitrides
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: A Linear-Regression based simple empirical model yielding RMSPE of 0.2341 to 3.01 is proposed for predicting the band-gap considering mean-atomic-number (r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>) and Axial-ratio (c/a) as predictors. The model self calibrated by the grown sample parameters predict a value of 2.86eV for Direct-E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> of hexagonal ScN and 1.35eV for tetragonal YN. This empirical tool established on statistical approach will be used industrially for finding Eg of semiconducting nitrides.

articleTitle: A machine learning model for predicting frequency of Low Power VCO considering process parameter variations
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Computers and Devices for Communication (CODEC)
abstract: A low-power CMOS Voltage Controlled Oscillator (VCO) becomes the subject of scrutiny, as LTspice simulations intertwine with machine learning finesse. This paper delves into the analysis of a low-power CMOS Voltage Controlled Oscillator (VCO) through LTspice simulations and machine learning techniques. Focusing on the VCO’s behaviour under low-power conditions, a Linear Regression based machine learning model has been automated to accurately predict VCO’s output frequency corresponding to process parameter variations of the constituent transistors.
